name: House Tang Guardian Cavalry to Tang Champion Progression

records.label: House Guardian Cavalry to Tang Champion

required_qualifications: discipline and House Tang loyalty review
facts.transaction: transfer a qualified conserved cohort slice from House Guardian Cavalry into the House Tang Tang Champion reserve; preserve cohort provenance and development; do not create anonymous exact people

records.label: Tang Champion aggregate representation policy
notes: Tang Champion is an institutional House Tang elite rank, not ownership by Tang Wei.
Anonymous Champions remain heterogeneous aggregate provenance/development cohorts. Their distributions preserve meaningful differences without one persistent NPC record per soldier.
Exact person state is created only when a Champion becomes named or materially relevant, and that transaction must debit one already-conserved body rather than creating headcount.
Assignment to Tang Wei or another commander moves the same institutional manpower allocation; it does not clone a roster.
